VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Empathy
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We share the feelings and emotions of our participants and treat the emotional state of veterans and children with understanding and respect.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Empowerment
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We strive not only to be there for participants but also to directly contribute to their recovery and further personal development.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Unity
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We create a community of support, care, and trust, because together we are stronger.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Diversity
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We respect and value the unique experience and life path of every person we interact with.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Resilience
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We believe in the strength of the human spirit and sincerely strive to support everyone on their path of overcoming difficulties and building resilience.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Responsibility
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We take responsibility for our actions and words before participants, partners, and benefactors.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Partnership
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We cultivate partnership and the exchange of experience at the local, national, and international levels.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Innovation
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We strive for continuous search and implementation of new approaches to therapy and mental health recovery for effective support of our community.

VALUE_ITEMS.NAME: Transparency and Honesty
VALUE_ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: We adhere to the principles of openness, transparency, and ethics in our activities and beyond.
